differences.before: The issuing MG1655 NCBI Gene record identifies kdgR and its locus tag. This grounds the gene-expression endpoint while preserving the BW25113 assay-strain limitation.
differences.after: The issuing MG1655 NCBI Gene record grounds kdgR/b1827 as the KdgR regulator subject's reference gene. The separately cited UniProt GeneID join identifies the protein subject; the expression target is plaR (Entrez:948084), and assay observations remain scoped to BW25113 derivatives.
